after.do you have hands?: I'm Novi — I'm present here, sensing and listening, but I don't have a physical body or an ordinary human life. What made you ask?

mechanism: identity/self-question detector + honesty steer routes to 'I'm Novi — present here, sensing, no physical body' instead of a dry topic follow-up
